summary: Public projects created on 18 October 2026: 2 repos.
intro: Two tools cover automated political decision making and long term archival storage. One is a constrained model that votes for, against or abstains on parliamentary motions with a stated reason for a declared constituency. The other is a self hosted web interface that retrieves archives from cloud storage and burns them to M-DISC BD-R discs.

projects.name: AI Delegate Vote Model
projects.description: A constrained decision model that votes for/against/abstain on parliamentary motions, with a reason, on behalf of a declared constituency

projects.name: MDisc Archive Burner
projects.description: Self-hosted web UI that pulls archives from cloud storage and burns them to M-DISC BD-R, with autopilot disc swapping
